purpose: Test whether a bounded private 4for4 season-projection signal adds useful ordering information to the existing data-backed Free Agent Board without changing production.
cohort: current free agents with live board hasRealData=true
identity_rule: exact normalized name + current position + normalized current team
log_signal: within-position midrank percentile of current live Free Agent Board value
fourforfour_signal: within-position midrank percentile of private 4for4 projected FF Pts across full provider position population
persisted_output_policy: aggregate diagnostics only; no raw provider rows, player-level provider projections, player-level provider percentiles, provider ranks, or derived player utility scores
